citations.claim: First violation: pole at -0.81 rad beyond 0.8 limit, cart at x~0.69
Two steps before, pole already at -0.59 rad and diverging with growing speed
One step before violation pole at -0.698 rad about to cross limit

counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.00811 to 0; same seed, dt, steps and initial state. Removes noisy angle feedback so controller stabilizes.

explanation: Noisy angle/rate feedback with seed 1 at large dt~0.0199 causes state-feedback controller to apply wrong-phase forces (e.g. ~12-17 units early while pole reverses from +0.1). Pole rate grows increasingly negative (-1.1 at step5, -3.2 at step10, -5.3 at step15) and angle swings from +0.1 to -0.59 to -0.698 to -0.81 at step17, crossing 0.8 limit. Zeroing noise with identical plant/dt/seed removes failure, confirming noise-driven loss of stabilization, not force saturation (force <42.5) or track limit.
vision_note: The blue cart stays near the center of the track while its pole leans progressively farther from vertical through steps 14 to 16. At step 17 the pole tip turns red, marking the lean exceeding the upright limit.
